title: Chatterbox, Turbo

tricks: Laugh, cough, giggle and sigh use Turbo's native tags
Pause is written as three plain dots, never the single ellipsis character, which Chatterbox turns into a comma
Turbo ignores exaggeration and cfg weight, so the sampler is the expressive knob

why: Chatterbox Turbo with its own sound tags and a slightly hotter sampler, cloned from the upbeat female clip.
